auditCaseId.title: Audit Case Id
auditCaseId.description: The 15- or 18-character Salesforce record Id of the Audit_Case__c the auditor is asking about.
auditCaseId.einstein:description: The 15- or 18-character Salesforce record Id of the Audit_Case__c the auditor is asking about. Audit Case Ids start with a05. Extract it directly from the user request, e.g. "summarize audit case a05gL00000JtZ74QAF".

replayCheckId.title: Replay Check Id
replayCheckId.description: Optional Id of the specific Replay_Check__c to draft the finding from.
replayCheckId.einstein:description: Optional Id of the specific Replay_Check__c to draft from. Replay Check Ids start with a06. Only include it if the user names a specific replay check.

ruleCode.title: Rule code
ruleCode.description: Optional rule code such as DTI_MAX naming the failed rule to draft a finding for.
ruleCode.einstein:description: Optional rule code such as DTI_MAX naming the failed rule to draft a finding for. Only include it if the user names a specific rule.
